summary: Peace activist Cindy Sheehan, who announced her intention to run as the Peace and Freedom Party's nominee for governor of California in 2014, took time to answer five questions from Wikinews reporter William S. Saturn. Sheehan, known for opposing the Iraq War after the death of her son Casey in 2004 and for protesting at President George W. Bush's ranch in Crawford, Texas, advocates revolutionary socialism, previously challenged Nancy Pelosi in 2008 (finishing second of seven) and was the Peace and Freedom Party's 2012 vice presidential nominee; other gubernatorial candidates include Governor Jerry Brown (Democrat), Abel Maldonado (Republican) and Luis J. Rodriguez (Green).
